name: bizplug-furniture
description: The furniture & home goods plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: browse pieces and request an order. It works from the business's own published profile, covering collections, materials, delivery and returns, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

test_cases.expect: Calls show_menu, which shows the menu card; does not list the options again, or lists them exactly as returned where there is no card.

test_cases.prompt: Browse pieces and request an order
test_cases.expect: Calls browse_collection and answers from the published profile.

test_cases.prompt: Does this sofa come in other colors, and when can you deliver?
test_cases.expect: Answers from the business profile, or says it is not covered and offers contact details.
Calls request_furniture_order only after the customer has confirmed the details, and reports that the business still has to confirm.
